# Load Injury Reports

Source: [`R/load_injuries.R`](https://github.com/nflverse/nflreadr/blob/main/R/load_injuries.R)

`load_injuries.Rd`

Data collected from an API for weekly injury report data.

## Usage [anchor](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/reference/load_injuries.html\#ref-usage)

```
load_injuries(
  seasons = most_recent_season(),
  file_type = getOption("nflreadr.prefer", default = "rds")
)
```

## Arguments [anchor](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/reference/load_injuries.html\#arguments)

seasons [anchor](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/reference/load_injuries.html#arg-seasons)

a numeric vector of seasons to return, data available since 2009. Defaults to latest season available.

file\_type [anchor](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/reference/load_injuries.html#arg-file-type)

One of `c("rds", "csv", "parquet")`. Can also be set globally with
`options(nflreadr.prefer)`

## Value [anchor](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/reference/load_injuries.html\#value)

a tibble of season-level injury report data.

## See also [anchor](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/reference/load_injuries.html\#see-also)

[https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/articles/dictionary\_injuries.html](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/articles/dictionary_injuries.html) for a web version of the dictionary

`dictionary_injuries` for the data dictionary as bundled within the package

Issues with this data should be filed here: [https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data](https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data)

## Examples [anchor](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/reference/load_injuries.html\#ref-examples)

```
# \donttest{
try({# prevents cran errors
    load_injuries(2020)
})
```
